name: Phrasal verbs
note: A verb + particle whose meaning is often idiomatic (give up, put off, look after, run out of). With many, an object pronoun goes in the middle (turn it on, not turn on it).

questions.q: I'm broke. I have to ______ an idea for making money.
questions.fs: I'm broke. I have to come up with an idea for making money.

questions.q: I decided to ______ my girlfriend and get married when I found out that her parents didn't like me because of my religion.
questions.fs: I decided to run away with my girlfriend and get married when I found out that her parents didn't like me because of my religion.

questions.q: An eagle, if pressed for food, might ______ a small baby that had been left in the open unprotected, but such an opportunity must occur very rarely.
questions.fs: An eagle, if pressed for food, might carry off a small baby that had been left in the open unprotected, but such an opportunity must occur very rarely.

questions.q: I don't mind helping you bake a cake, but just make sure you ______ everything when you've finished.
questions.fs: I don't mind helping you bake a cake, but just make sure you put away everything when you've finished.

questions.q: When I hit my head on the cupboard, I almost ______
questions.fs: When I hit my head on the cupboard, I almost knocked myself out.

questions.q: It's easy to see from the way the garden is looking that winter has ______
questions.fs: It's easy to see from the way the garden is looking that winter has set in.

questions.q: You've borrowed such a great deal of money from me lately. I need to ______ exactly how much you owe me.
questions.fs: You've borrowed such a great deal of money from me lately. I need to work out exactly how much you owe me.

questions.q: My family finally made the painful decision to admit my grandmother to a nursing home, as she is no longer capable of ______ herself.
questions.fs: My family finally made the painful decision to admit my grandmother to a nursing home, as she is no longer capable of looking after herself.

questions.q: I need to find some kind of chemical that will ______ the weeds in the garden.
questions.fs: I need to find some kind of chemical that will keep down the weeds in the garden.

questions.q: I don't know how you ______ with such noisy brothers. It would drive me crazy.
questions.fs: I don't know how you put up with such noisy brothers. It would drive me crazy.

questions.q: Kathleen felt like she had to ______ with a lot from her family.
questions.fs: Kathleen felt like she had to put up with a lot from her family.

questions.q: China's cultural industry was given a boost last week after the government announced its plan to ______ cultural reform in more than 20 provincial areas.
questions.fs: China's cultural industry was given a boost last week after the government announced its plan to carry out cultural reform in more than 20 provincial areas.

questions.q: The government wants to ______ a new scheme to encourage people to start their own businesses.
questions.fs: The government wants to try out a new scheme to encourage people to start their own businesses.

questions.q: The mayor has allowed vendors to ______ to their old place after many of them complained of lowered income following the implementation of the night market last week.
questions.fs: The mayor has allowed vendors to go back to their old place after many of them complained of lowered income following the implementation of the night market last week.

questions.q: You can tell by the way she talks and behaves that she ______ her mother.
questions.fs: You can tell by the way she talks and behaves that she takes after her mother.

questions.q: That maths exam was incredibly difficult. It took me ages to ______ some of the answers.
questions.fs: That maths exam was incredibly difficult. It took me ages to work out some of the answers.

questions.q: I just can't seem to be able to find a good personal assistant; they are so hard to ______
questions.fs: I just can't seem to be able to find a good personal assistant; they are so hard to come by.

questions.q: The time has now come when it will be necessary to ______ making a plan.
questions.fs: The time has now come when it will be necessary to see about making a plan.

questions.q: Can you ______ the time of the next train to Munich?
questions.fs: Can you find out the time of the next train to Munich?

questions.q: The kids ______ Trent because he is different.
questions.fs: The kids pick on Trent because he is different.

questions.q: Items such as pointed scissors and ice skates are examples of articles that are not permitted in your ______ baggage when boarding an aircraft.
questions.fs: Items such as pointed scissors and ice skates are examples of articles that are not permitted in your carry on baggage when boarding an aircraft.

questions.q: I'm sorry, James isn't ______ at the moment. Can I take a message?
questions.fs: I'm sorry, James isn't in at the moment. Can I take a message?

questions.q: Approximately 27,000?? 29,000 vehicles ______ the Detroit-Windsor Tunnel on a daily basis.
questions.fs: Approximately 27,000?? 29,000 vehicles pass through the Detroit-Windsor Tunnel on a daily basis.

questions.q: You need not worry that you'll be left on your own because I'll always ______ you.
questions.fs: You need not worry that you'll be left on your own because I'll always stand by you.

questions.q: Our teacher told us to ______ our work quietly.
questions.fs: Our teacher told us to get on with our work quietly.

questions.q: Laurie decided to ______ after the fourth ring.
questions.fs: Laurie decided to hang up after the fourth ring.

questions.q: Last week I ______ that book you wanted in a small shop.
questions.fs: Last week I came across that book you wanted in a small shop.

questions.q: We've run ______ sugar. Could you please buy some more?
questions.fs: We've run out of sugar. Could you please buy some more?

questions.q: People are getting tired of Seth because he always ______ late.
questions.fs: People are getting tired of Seth because he always shows up late.

questions.q: India and Iran will continue to deepen ties and ______ bilateral projects, including the tri-nation pipeline and a multi-billion dollar gas deal.
questions.fs: India and Iran will continue to deepen ties and carry on with bilateral projects, including the tri-nation pipeline and a multi-billion dollar gas deal.

questions.q: I want to ______ the dinner tonight so that you don't have to worry about feeding your kids.
questions.fs: I want to bring over the dinner tonight so that you don't have to worry about feeding your kids.

questions.q: When irrigation has no ______ system, the evaporating water deposits a gradual build-up of salinization, which is eventually damaging to plant life.
questions.fs: When irrigation has no carry off system, the evaporating water deposits a gradual build-up of salinization, which is eventually damaging to plant life.

questions.q: Before Sheila died from a long battle with cancer, she asked her sister to ______ her children.
questions.fs: Before Sheila died from a long battle with cancer, she asked her sister to look after her children.

questions.q: Finland and the Finnish upper secondary education system constitute a good example of the fact that it is possible to ______ very extensive readjustments with a view to making a system more flexible and adapted to individualized learning.
questions.fs: Finland and the Finnish upper secondary education system constitute a good example of the fact that it is possible to carry through very extensive readjustments with a view to making a system more flexible and adapted to individualized learning.

questions.q: A Russian culture festival on Tajik territory has been ______ indefinitely because of a local typhoid fever outbreak.
questions.fs: A Russian culture festival on Tajik territory has been put off indefinitely because of a local typhoid fever outbreak.

questions.q: When spring comes, people often feel inclined to ______ their houses.
questions.fs: When spring comes, people often feel inclined to do up their houses.

questions.q: If you ______ the numbers, it will be easier to calculate the estimate.
questions.fs: If you round off the numbers, it will be easier to calculate the estimate.

questions.q: The Scottish Parliament has appointed Mr. Maley to ______ an assessment of the current cost estimate and likely completion date of a new information technology project.
questions.fs: The Scottish Parliament has appointed Mr. Maley to carry out an assessment of the current cost estimate and likely completion date of a new information technology project.

questions.q: When disaster strikes, will your insurer ______ for you?
questions.fs: When disaster strikes, will your insurer come through for you?

questions.q: Don't worry we'll have to wait a little longer because I'm sure he'll ______ soon.
questions.fs: Don't worry we'll have to wait a little longer because I'm sure he'll turn up soon.

questions.q: Kevin ______ the great opportunity to be the floor manager.
questions.fs: Kevin jumped all over the great opportunity to be the floor manager.

questions.q: If you want to join that club, you have to ______ a form and send it to your secretary.
questions.fs: If you want to join that club, you have to fill out a form and send it to your secretary.

questions.q: Karen had to ______ for Dave while he was away on vacation.
questions.fs: Karen had to fill in for Dave while he was away on vacation.

questions.q: What you have to do is to ______ a new idea that will enable us to make a lot of money.
questions.fs: What you have to do is to think up a new idea that will enable us to make a lot of money.

questions.q: The teacher asked her students to ______ the assignments by Friday at noon.
questions.fs: The teacher asked her students to turn in the assignments by Friday at noon.

questions.q: The liver regulates most chemical levels in the blood and excretes a product called bile, which helps ______ waste products from the liver.
questions.fs: The liver regulates most chemical levels in the blood and excretes a product called bile, which helps carry away waste products from the liver.

questions.q: Randy was very nervous during his first flight lesson. Afterwards, he told me the best part was at the beginning, during ______
questions.fs: Randy was very nervous during his first flight lesson. Afterwards, he told me the best part was at the beginning, during take off.

questions.q: Animals and humans use the evaporation of water to ______ heat that is absorbed from the sun or generated by metabolic activity and exercise.
questions.fs: Animals and humans use the evaporation of water to carry away heat that is absorbed from the sun or generated by metabolic activity and exercise.

questions.q: Ken really likes Kirstie, but he's too nervous to ______
questions.fs: Ken really likes Kirstie, but he's too nervous to ask her out.

questions.q: An employee with 400 accrued sick leave hours at the end of the fiscal year will ______ into the new fiscal year 360 hours of sick leave and 8 hours of additional annual leave.
questions.fs: An employee with 400 accrued sick leave hours at the end of the fiscal year will carry over into the new fiscal year 360 hours of sick leave and 8 hours of additional annual leave.

questions.q: Candace has a bad habit of ______ in front of others.
questions.fs: Candace has a bad habit of butting in in front of others.

questions.q: Marg wanted to ______ the old sofa, but her husband couldn't part with it.
questions.fs: Marg wanted to throw out the old sofa, but her husband couldn't part with it.

questions.q: The treasurer assured his constituents that he would ______ the scandal shortly after the results of the general election were made public.
questions.fs: The treasurer assured his constituents that he would look into the scandal shortly after the results of the general election were made public.

questions.q: The Australian Labour Party doesn't currently have any politicians that would be capable of successfully ______ the Prime Minister at the next federal election.
questions.fs: The Australian Labour Party doesn't currently have any politicians that would be capable of successfully running against the Prime Minister at the next federal election.

questions.q: A 27-year-old Canadian woman confused the weekend with a weekday and ______ her 6-year-old at school on a Saturday.
questions.fs: A 27-year-old Canadian woman confused the weekend with a weekday and dropped off her 6-year-old at school on a Saturday.

questions.q: The supervisor asked everyone to ______ for the manager's birthday present.
questions.fs: The supervisor asked everyone to chip in for the manager's birthday present.

questions.q: The thieves managed to ______ with a lot of money, but a year later, they were apprehended and sentenced to 50 years in prison.
questions.fs: The thieves managed to get away with a lot of money, but a year later, they were apprehended and sentenced to 50 years in prison.

questions.q: Kelly ______ her mother. They have many of the same interests.
questions.fs: Kelly takes after her mother. They have many of the same interests.

questions.q: Steve was always trying to ______ girls at the nightclub.
questions.fs: Steve was always trying to pick up girls at the nightclub.

questions.q: Most of the service stations decided to ______ their gas prices after the gas war between them.
questions.fs: Most of the service stations decided to jack up their gas prices after the gas war between them.

questions.q: Deciduous trees send messages to leaves telling them when to ______
questions.fs: Deciduous trees send messages to leaves telling them when to fall off.

questions.q: He is different, so many children ______ him.
questions.fs: He is different, so many children make fun of him.

questions.q: Pakistani viewers will no longer be able to watch their favorite Bollywood movies, as the government has decided that all Indian cable channels will ______ the air at the end of this month.
questions.fs: Pakistani viewers will no longer be able to watch their favorite Bollywood movies, as the government has decided that all Indian cable channels will go off the air at the end of this month.

questions.q: A total stranger walked ______ to me and asked if I could lend him some money.
questions.fs: A total stranger walked up to me and asked if I could lend him some money.

questions.q: Lenny didn't ______ when his superior reprimanded him.
questions.fs: Lenny didn't back down when his superior reprimanded him.

questions.q: If natural disasters have anything good about them, it may be the compassion they ______ in people.
questions.fs: If natural disasters have anything good about them, it may be the compassion they bring out in people.

questions.q: Many children try to ______ from home for one reason or another at least once during their childhood.
questions.fs: Many children try to run away from home for one reason or another at least once during their childhood.

questions.q: U2 will not ______ the online release of the band's new album, following news that it has been leaked onto the Internet.
questions.fs: U2 will not bring forward the online release of the band's new album, following news that it has been leaked onto the Internet.

questions.q: The manager was terrified that his employees would stop work and walk ______ without warning.
questions.fs: The manager was terrified that his employees would stop work and walk out without warning.

questions.q: Indonesia's fuel subsidies could ______ 100 trillion Rupiah ($9.6 billion) due to high prices and fuel scarcity in parts of the world's fourth most populous country, its president said on Tuesday.
questions.fs: Indonesia's fuel subsidies could go over 100 trillion Rupiah ($9.6 billion) due to high prices and fuel scarcity in parts of the world's fourth most populous country, its president said on Tuesday.

questions.q: The slips fieldsman moved quickly to his left and then flung himself further leftwards to ______ a spectacular catch.
questions.fs: The slips fieldsman moved quickly to his left and then flung himself further leftwards to bring off a spectacular catch.

questions.q: Our dog loves to ______ the mail truck.
questions.fs: Our dog loves to run after the mail truck.

questions.q: They rented a car so it would be easier to ______ the new city.
questions.fs: They rented a car so it would be easier to get around the new city.

questions.q: Jeff felt as if he had been ______ when he lost his job.
questions.fs: Jeff felt as if he had been let down when he lost his job.

questions.q: He came into the room, shouted at everybody and then left the room walking ______ in a really bad temper.
questions.fs: He came into the room, shouted at everybody and then left the room walking off in a really bad temper.

questions.q: Bruce ______ of school when he was only fifteen years old and then took on a job.
questions.fs: Bruce dropped out of school when he was only fifteen years old and then took on a job.

questions.q: A burglar ______ my house when I was away on vacation and stole some of my electronic goods.
questions.fs: A burglar broke into my house when I was away on vacation and stole some of my electronic goods.

questions.q: The rich families ______ poor people in this area.
questions.fs: The rich families look down on poor people in this area.

questions.q: Jeremy didn't want to ______ the wedding any longer.
questions.fs: Jeremy didn't want to put off the wedding any longer.

questions.q: Neil liked to ______ early on Saturdays.
questions.fs: Neil liked to wake up early on Saturdays.

questions.q: The referee instructed both captains to stop their complaining and ______ the rugby match.
questions.fs: The referee instructed both captains to stop their complaining and get on with the rugby match.

questions.q: Samantha was late for the basketball ______
questions.fs: Samantha was late for the basketball tryout.

questions.q: Rick ______ a terrible cold this week.
questions.fs: Rick came down with a terrible cold this week.

questions.q: I ______ on my friend yesterday to surprise her.
questions.fs: I dropped in on my friend yesterday to surprise her.

questions.q: It was reported that the Government is expected to ______ stringent norms to prevent "predatory takeovers" of Indian private banks.
questions.fs: It was reported that the Government is expected to come up with stringent norms to prevent "predatory takeovers" of Indian private banks.

questions.q: Lisa was ______ her friends to help her move.
questions.fs: Lisa was counting on her friends to help her move.

questions.q: Rosie overslept because her alarm clock didn't ______ this morning.
questions.fs: Rosie overslept because her alarm clock didn't go off this morning.

questions.q: Jim didn't have much time to ______ the contract.
questions.fs: Jim didn't have much time to write up the contract.

questions.q: I usually ______ work at about 4 o'clock and run to the station to catch the train to my next job.
questions.fs: I usually knock off work at about 4 o'clock and run to the station to catch the train to my next job.

questions.q: He worked hard to ______ to Berkeley last year.
questions.fs: He worked hard to get in to Berkeley last year.
